blockers.hand_joint_identity: REAL_G1 metadata has no named per-slot hand joints, signs, zero references or hand asset revision. DREAM uses thumb_0,thumb_1,thumb_2,middle_0,middle_1,index_0,index_1; action statistics have four same-sign flexion ranges first, incompatible with this provisional identity. Statistics cannot distinguish index from middle or establish morphology.
blockers.body_joint_identity: Arm and waist dimensions and ranges fit DREAM but named order, signs, zero references and units are not specified by the checkpoint schema.
blockers.wrist_physical_frame: XYZ_ROT6D row convention and local relative composition verified; training origin/link and parent frame are unspecified. DREAM used wrist_yaw_link in pelvis coordinates.
blockers.camera: Checkpoint requires ego_view. Saved input is an external fixed RGB-D camera; training intrinsics/extrinsics and viewpoint adaptation are unverified.
blockers.frequency: History indices [-20,0] and horizon [0..39] are verified; trained sampling Hz, action Hz, latency handling and execution schedule are unspecified. DREAM assumed 20 Hz, with actual saved frames one second apart.
blockers.command_arbitration: No verified arbitration between redundant wrist EEF and arm joint outputs, or supported-pelvis treatment of base_height_command and navigate_command.

physical_units.wrist: translation in training dataset coordinate units (not declared by schema); ROT6D dimensionless
physical_units.arms_hands_waist: training joint values; radians plausible from robot/statistics, not an independently verified named physical mapping
physical_units.base_height_command: one absolute scalar; reference and units unspecified
physical_units.navigate_command: three absolute scalars; axis meanings, frames and units unspecified

hand_hypothesis: Four finger flexion slots then three thumb slots is consistent with statistics; no index/middle order or permutation authorized.

recording.status: no physical episode: mapping blocked before actuation
recording.required_for_future_physical_run: Capture actual control-run state snapshots and timestamped events; render wide and close views offline at 15-24 FPS >=720p to external storage. Preserve originals and encode MP4 with source/model/config/seed manifest; highlights only after independent success. No separate scripted episode.
